items.title: Sandisk Stock Is Having Its Best Day Since January. It Has Had a Tough Month.
items.summary: The stock was the session’s leading performer in the  and notched its largest daily percentage gain since Jan. 6.  It’s likely  Sandisk  received a boost from  Samsung Electronics  ’ strong earnings and remarks suggesting memory supply shortages will last through 2028.  Sandisk stock remains down 45% in July and is still on pace to log its worst monthly performance on record, according to Dow Jones Market Data.

items.title: Sandisk, Micron, Apple, SpaceX, Samsung, Microsoft, Meta, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Investors were weighing a batch of Big Tech earnings reports and data that showed inflation softening in June.  Microsoft  advanced 16% after the software giant reported strong fiscal fourth-quarter results and said its capital expenditures guidance for the year remained the same, easing fears about overspending on artificial intelligence.  Meta Platforms  dropped 8% after the Facebook parent missed Wall Street’s second-quarter earnings target and failed to get investors to buy in on its AI spending plans.
